articleTitle: Optimisation of a Method Based on Spectrophotometric Determination of Total Triterpenes in Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Spectrophotometric methods have been widely used in the determination of total triterpenes in traditional Chinese medicines due to their ease of operation, short time duration, and the absence of the need for all controls of the tested components. However, many of the existing methods directly analyse the extracts of traditional Chinese medicines for the determination of total triterpenoids, without exploring whether other chemical components in traditional Chinese medicines interfere with the determination and whether they need to be decontaminated. In order to address this problem, the researchers chose liquorice and hawthorn leaves as the subjects for the study, and identified the optimal colourimetric system for liquorice and hawthorn leaves by comparing the differences of four methods, namely, sulfuric acid, vanillin-sulfuric acid, perchloric acid and vanillin-perchloric acid methods. At the same time, it was also investigated whether the total extracts of the herbs without decontamination treatment would have any effect on the results of total triterpene content determination. The experimental data clearly showed that the determined content of total triterpenes in the total extracts without decontamination treatment was significantly higher than that in the extracts with decontamination treatment. Therefore, for the determination of specific components in traditional Chinese medicine, it is necessary to explore the methods to remove the interfering substances, and at the same time to find the optimal colourimetric system according to the material to ensure the accuracy of the content determination. This study provides scientific support for the determination of target components in traditional Chinese medicine and helps to improve the accuracy of the determination. The practical significance of this study will not only be reflected in the quality evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine, but will also have a profound impact on the traditional Chinese medicine industry, the pharmaceutical field and public health.

articleTitle: Design of a Sound Source Multidimensional Positioning System Based on TDOA
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The sound source multidimensional positioning and tracking system designed here is composed of microphone array, two-dimensional cradle head, power step-down device, laser indicating device, LCD display and main control MAIX Dock. The microphone array is the data acquisition part, the two-dimensional cradle head and laser indicating device is the action execution part, LCD display is the data display part, and MAIX Dock is the control core. It can realize accurate sound source positioning, and mark the position of the sound source by laser. It has strong anti-interference ability, and can dynamically track the moving sound source, and describe the motion trajectory of the sound source through the display screen.

articleTitle: A Method for Building an Emotional Clothing Design Teaching Scaffold Based on ENA Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Emotional clothing design is a clothing design concept that focuses on emotions and pays attention to people's inner needs and emotional expression. Empowering clothing design based on individual emotions is a generative design behavior that helps learners innovate knowledge and trigger deeper cognitive processes, actively reflecting their design level and high-level design abilities. The research focuses on 28 undergraduate students majoring in fashion design, designing and implementing a pro class learning framework for emotional fashion design teaching. Based on the generative text data in the learning feedback form during the teaching process, using content analysis, descriptive statistical analysis, and cognitive network analysis methods, this study explores the enhancing role of emotional stimulation in capturing and empowering fashion design inspiration from a phased development perspective. Research has found that during the dynamic development of curriculum teaching, diverse emotional generative issues gradually increase, and students' cognitive level shifts towards deep cognitive development of explaining and refining viewpoints. Through elements such as color, pattern, and material, designers' emotional views are conveyed, enabling designers and consumers to feel happy, comfortable, and confident when wearing these clothing.

articleTitle: Leveraging Information Technology and Data Analytics for Sustainable Corporate Practices: A Case Study on the Impact of Green Finance Policies
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper utilizes panel data from China's A-share listed companies spanning from 2008 to 2021. Based on the policy impact of China's establishment of green finance reform and innovation pilot zones in 2017, it uses the amount of corporate environmental protection investment as an indicator to measure corporate environmental performance. It constructs a difference-in-differences model to investigate the impact of green finance policies on corporate environmental performance. The results demonstrate that green finance policies significantly enhance corporate environmental performance at the 1% significance level. The robustness of these empirical findings is confirmed through parallel trend tests and placebo tests. The conclusions drawn from this study offer valuable policy insights for promoting and deepening the reform and innovation of green finance. The government should guide financial institutions to facilitate loans and financing for green projects and green enterprises, with a particular focus on supporting small and medium-sized enterprises that may be less affected by the benefits of green finance policies. Expanding the coverage and support for green finance policies is essential for fostering environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Weakness of Enhanced DNA and ElGamal Cryptosystem for Secure Data Storage and Retrieval in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: DNA cryptography has been developed for nearly thirty years, and there is a lot of research on DNA based encryption and decryption. In 2018, Thangavel and Varlakshmi proposed an article “Enhanced DNA and ElGamal cryptosystem for secure data storage and retrieval in cloud”, they provide two cryptosystem schemes DNA and ElGamal. In this paper the authors would like to analyze security to DNA scheme, this is our research goal. We also prove it may occur insecure when the XOR operation using in special environment. The mathematical Proof and experimental evidence be demonstrated in this article, this is our method. The results point out it is not secure to Thangavel and Varlakshmi's DNA protocol.

articleTitle: Research on the Promotion of Higher Vocational Labor Education Reform by Artificial Intelligence in the Era of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Digitalization is an extension of information development. In the era of “digitalization”, higher vocational labor education is enabled by artificial intelligence technology. Based on the development background of education digitalization and the development trend of higher vocational labor education, this paper analyzes the value of artificial intelligence to labor education, the opportunities and challenges of artificial intelligence to labor education development, and explores the path of artificial intelligence to promote labor education reform. Continuously strengthen the consciousness, establish the concept, cultivate the attitude, safeguard mechanism, carry out the practice and reflection, and promote the reform and development of higher vocational labor education.

articleTitle: Research on the Intervention Mechanism of Online Social Anxiety among College Students Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Online social anxiety refers to individuals' perception of negative interpersonal experiences in social media interactions. In order to study the intervention mechanism of online social anxiety, a hypothesis was proposed using individual emotional intelligence as the independent variable, online social anxiety as the dependent variable, and core self-evaluation as the mediating variable. And SPSS22.0 software, AMOS210 software, and MPLUS7.0 software were used to process and analyze data from 563 college students to verify hypotheses. The results show that (1) College students are experiencing high levels of online social anxiety. (2) There exists a substantial correlation between emotional intelligence, core self-evaluation and online social anxiety. Online social anxiety is negatively associated with core self-evaluation and emotional intelligence. Moreover, there exists a positive correlation between emotional intelligence and core self-evaluation. (3) Emotional intelligence associated with Online social anxiety (p<0.001) mediated by core self-evaluation (proportion of effect mediated = 55.88%). Specifically, the emotional intelligence of college students has a direct impact on online social anxiety and also exerts an indirect influence through the mediating effect of core self-evaluation. Finally, some solutions targeted at the problem of online social anxiety among college students were proposed.

articleTitle: A New Adaptive Image Sharpening Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The sharpening is a scheme applied to highlight the intensity transitions in an image. This enhancement increases edge acutance and significantly improves the overall sharpness of processed images. Image sharpening is also of enormous importance in medicine for diagnosis. Noise overshoot and over-sharpening effects occur in traditional sharpening algorithms. The adaptive approach skips the noise producing a better sharpening result. Abrupt pixel value changes, if adequately emphasized, can be utilized effectively in the sharpening process. Since a residual image contains noise with edges, the bigger the filter size the greater the content of edges left in the residual image. Two residual images are produced first with different filter sizes and assumed a relationship between two residuals. A simple linear regression is measured using these residuals. This linear equation is an expectation and the deviation is the difference between two residuals. The window may contain edges if the residual value measured by larger size filter to some degree higher than that by smaller size filter. One standard deviation (±σ) is proposed as the threshold, in this work. A sensitive sharpening filter is adaptively then applied to those locations in image. It has been demonstrated that the proposed approach yields better results than the global sharpening filter on the measurements of Pratt's <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> indices. A sharpening scheme without latent image noise amplification is useful for pattern recognition and machine-learning. In the future this scheme will be used to preprocess image segmentation and medical image.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Lie Detection Based on Eye-Tracking Data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Eye-tracking technology has advanced and found applications in diverse fields. In the domain of lie detection, eye-tracking offers a novel approach by capturing real-time data during visual information viewing, unveiling cognitive characteristics. Its non-invasive, ecological, and efficient nature holds promise for lie detection. This study introduces eye-tracking and conducts a lie-detection experiment using the Comprehensive Cognitive Test (CCT). Eye-movement indicators are collected using an eye-tracking instrument, and the SVM learning model verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of eye-tracking in lie detection.

articleTitle: Fusion of Fusion of Technique and Art, And Merging Media Innovation: Exploration on the Cross-Integration Teaching of“ Web Front-End Development Foundation” and “New Media Advertising Creativity and Design”
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the integration construction of the course “Web Front-end Development Foundation” for software engineering major and the course “New Media Advertising Creativity and Design” for visual communication major in Communication University of Zhejiang, this paper explores the cross-integration teaching mode of media interdisciplinary courses by combining the practical experience in three aspects: inspiring internal drive, promoting teaching through competition, and meeting industry standards. Good feedback has been received in the improvement of software engineering students' professional skills, the leap in the quality of visual communication students' works, and the excellent results of interdisciplinary competition teams.

articleTitle: Harnessing Information Technology for Improving eHealth Literacy Among Young Adults: Lessons from the COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study investigated the impact of COVID-19 on eHealth literacy among young individuals by surveying 300 university students in Qingdao City, Shandong Province. We utilized an e-health literacy questionnaire and analyzed the data using SPSS 25.0. The respondents achieved an overall e-health literacy score of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{28.12 \pm 8.46}$</tex>, with “I know how to acquire valuable health information online” scoring the highest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{3.59 \pm 0.99})$</tex> and “I know how to locate useful health information online” scoring the lowest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{3.31 \pm 1.20})$</tex>. While the prevalence of COVID-19 has positively influenced university students' interest in eHealth and boosted their eHealth literacy, there remains room for improvement. Addressing privacy and security concerns in e-health software usage among young people is imperative. Guiding students through health education is essential to ensure their accurate utilization of health information, ultimately enhancing their health self-management capabilities and overall self-efficacy.

articleTitle: Construction and Service Deployment of Data Service Platforms in Smart Libraries of Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper integrates theoretical studies on smart library data construction with practical explorations in data services, addressing the limitations of technologies like the Internet of Things, big data, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence. It proposes several implementation strategies for constructing smart libraries in higher education institutions. These include improving the design of data collection indicators, enhancing the methods for collecting data on reader intentions, leveraging data scientifically to make libraries smarter, emphasizing the role of librarians in data collection, building next-generation library service platforms, enhancing the intelligent service capabilities of librarians, and strengthening the relationship between libraries and their readers, all aimed at truly realizing intelligent services in smart libraries.

articleTitle: The Application Law of the Flos Inulae in “Tai Ping Sheng Hui Fang” Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the medication pattern of flos inulae-containig-Ta I ping Sheng hui Fang, and to lay a basis for modern clinical medication. Methods: Excel2021, SPSS modeler 18.0, and SPSS Statistics 27 software, the frequency methods statistics, association rule statistics, and cluster analysis were used to collect the prescriptions containing flos inulae in Tai ping Sheng hui Fang, and statistically analyzed the effective prescriptions.. Results: 157 formulas with 148 flavors were included in “Taiping Shenghui Fang”, with a total frequency of 1519 times, 21 flavors were used in high frequency, and the top 10 medicines in order of frequency were: Flos Inulae, Licorice, Red Poria cocos, Peucedani Radix, Pinellia ternate, Fructus aurantia, Ginseng, Saposhnikoviae Radi, White mulberry root-bark, Betel nut and Cassia twig. The efficacy categories of the drugs are mainly focused on phlegm-transtorming cough-stopping and panting-alleviating medicines, Tonic medicines and Exterior-releasing medicines; and the medicinal properties are mainly warm and slightly cold; bitter flavor and pungent flavor are the main flavors of the medicine. Lungs and spleen are meridian affinity of the medicine. Most of the dosage forms are powder. The association rules yielded 19 combinations its main treatment diseases were mainly phlegm-fluid disorders, and its association rules yielded 23 combinations, which were categorized into 4 classes by cluster analysis. Conclusions: In the formula of Tai ping Sheng hui fang containing the flos inulae, in addition to being combined with other drugs in this category, flos inulae is often used in combination with drugs, which is tonic medicines, and is often used in phlegm-fluid retention, and it can be used as a reference for the clinical applications.

articleTitle: Review of Adapter Signature Scheme Based on ISRSAC Digital Signature Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The RSA cryptosystem is well-known in the entire world. An adaptor signature system based on the ISRSAC digital signature algorithm has been proposed by Zhang, Liu, Yuan and Yang. This idea has been adapted from the ISRSAC scheme by Indian academics Thangavel and Varalakshmi. However, the ISRSAC algorithm may exist flaw. When Zhang, Liu, Yuan and Yang proposed their scheme based on ISRSAC algorithm, it also may occur same flaw. In this paper the authors analyze the security upon ISRSAC algorithm, it is our research goal. And the authors will mention the key point problem by mathematical proof and experimental data to ISRSAC algorithm, those are our methods. According the analyze results of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha(n)$</tex>, it does not always an integer. Thus, this scheme has flaw and it is not secure. We conclude our claim in the final section.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Teaching Geography Pre-Research Trip Curriculum -- Taking Bada Shanren as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The main goal of the research study pre-trip course is to stock up the field teaching knowledge of the research study trip in order to improve the quality of field teaching. This paper explains in detail how to utilize virtual reality technology for the teaching of research study pre-trip courses, introduces the process of course design, and aims to innovate the learning method of core literacy in geography to provide reference for the design of secondary school geography research study pre-trip courses.

articleTitle: Design of 5G Rectangular Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the gradual maturity of 5G mobile communication technology, the antenna, a key hub of the transmission and reception of electromagnetic wave signals, will be updated continuously. The antenna technology is becoming more matched with the frequency band of 5G communication, and better for the reception and transmission efficiency of signals. A rectangular microstrip antenna model which is suitable for 5G wireless communication is built by using HFSS simulation software. Its central working frequency reaches about 4.8GHz, the echo loss is -53.03dB, the maximum bandwidth of the antenna at 10dB is about 162MHz, and the maximum gain is 3.41dB. In order to rise the gain, a 2×3 antenna array composed of multiple identical rectangular antennas is designed. It can improve the maximum bandwidth to 709MHz and the gain to 11.01dB. Compared with ordinary antennas, the two antennas designed have smaller size and can be integrated with other devices. Both of them have good direction, and the antenna performance are also outstanding.

articleTitle: Research on the Online Teaching Model for Information-Related Courses in Higher Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Online education has been widely applied in the field of vocational education. However, the large-scale and comprehensive implementation of online teaching models across all specialties in vocational education still face significant challenges. This article combines the characteristics of vocational classroom teaching to conduct in-depth research on various aspects of online teaching, including content, formats, approaches, and the teaching process. Particularly focusing on information-related disciplines that integrate theory with practice, this paper presents corresponding implementation strategies and improvement suggestions.

articleTitle: Study on the Physical Development of Primary School Students in Urban and Rural Areas by Measuring of Palm Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The study included 226 students from grades 1 to 6, with an equal distribution between rural and urban schools. The aim of this study was to analyze the physical development of the students, taking into account factors such as age, gender, height, weight, and palm size. The study specifically focused on examining the relationship between palm grip strength and other physical indicators. Data encompassed age, gender, height, weight, finger length, palm width, and grip strength for both hands. Results revealed that urban students had significantly wider palms than their rural counterparts (p < 0.05). A positive correlation was found between finger length and palm width, especially pronounced in rural areas. Although there was no significant difference in grip strength between the hands, urban students demonstrated higher average grip strength. In conclusion, palm grip strength correlates with physical development, and urban students tend to develop faster than their rural peers, providing valuable insights for education and health policies.

articleTitle: Spherical Detection Frame and Attention-Based Pulmonary Nodule Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the cancers with the highest incidence and mortality in the world, and early detection of lung nodules can effectively reduce the mortality rate of lung cancer. At present, most of the lung nodule detection methods based on deep learning face the problem of low sensitivity or high false positive rate. This paper proposes a loss function suitable for the clinical features of lung nodules and introduces a novel Squeeze-and-Excitation module in the depth direction, which alleviates the problem of high false positive rate in the detection process and achieves good results. In this paper, the competition performance metric (CPM) on the LUNA16 dataset reached 88.16%.

articleTitle: DCAM-Net: Sheep Gender Identification Network Based on Dilated Convolutional Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Automatic identification of the genders of sheep can be valuable to the sheep industry. Sheep producers need to identify the genders of sheep to forecast the population variation of their flock and combine it with some research works on sheep faces. Yet, in many cases, farmers find it difficult to distinguish the gender of sheep when do not have a great deal of experience. But, recent advancements in deep learning in computer vision will help to classify sheep's gender quickly and accurately. In this paper, we propose a novel sheep gender identification network based on dilated convolutional attention module (DCAM-Net). In the framework, multi-stage and multi-scale feature fusion effectively captures multi-scale features to resist noise interference and scale changes. Additionally, we design a channel and spatial attention module called the dilated convolutional attention module (DCAM) to promote the network to better focus on foreground information and suppress background information. There is no publicly available dataset with enough data for gender recognition in deep architectures. Therefore, to address the problem, we build a dataset of 8768 sheep images of 428 rams and 420 ewes acquired on a farm and annotated by an expert. We test the performance of DCAM-Net on the sheep face dataset, and the experimental results prove the superiority of the proposed method and the attention module.

articleTitle: Research on Detection of Compromised Campus Accounts Based on Features of Logging into Different Business Systems from Different Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Detecting compromised campus accounts is of great significance to protecting the information security of colleges and universities. This paper proposes a method to use a machine learning model to analyze account sign-in logs to detect compromised campus accounts. The proposed method detects the compromised campus accounts mainly by analyzing the number and frequency of user accounts logging into different campus business systems in off-campus and on-campus network environments. This paper uses the proposed method to extract the features of campus users from the authentication logs of a university for three consecutive months, and then train the machine learning model, and then verify the prediction effect. The results show that the proposed method achieves a detection rate of up to 87.08% with a false-positive rate of 0.08% in identifying compromised campus accounts.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Reform of Computer Hardware Courses Through-Teaching Based on Results-Oriented
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Due to the strong foundation, extensive knowledge content and high practical requirements of hardware courses in computer majors, traditional teaching methods often struggle to adequately support the achievement of the skills and knowledge demanded by engineering education professional certification. In this paper, we propose the idea of reorganizing the knowledge system of computer major series hardware courses through course group integration. We aim to redesign the entire teaching process of each hardware course in alignment with the graduation goals. Guided by the student-centered teaching theory, we actively explore the transformation of teaching elements, including teaching subjects, objectives, methods, situations and evaluation. Recent hardware teaching practices have demonstrated a significant improvement in students' interest and engagement in hardware courses, as well as their engineering literacy and ability to solve complex problems related to computer hardware systems.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Transfer Learning Method for Tea Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Tea has been widely planted across the world, while the identification of tea disease is mainly based on human expertise. In recent years, there has been an increasing use of deep learning techniques for the recognition of plant diseases. However, persistent challenges such as the limited availability of comprehensive datasets and the need to improve recognition accuracy still exist in tea disease identification. To address these issues, we collect a small-scale tea disease image dataset, containing 203 images covering six common tea disease. Then, we proposed a two-stage transfer learning approach for improving the accuracy. Firstly, we modified the first stage in ResNet50 to better extracting image feature. Next, we leverage a two-stage transfer learning approach which first transfers to a related intermediate PlantVillage dataset. The proposed model achieved a recognition accuracy of 87.67% when trained from scratch on the tea leaf dataset, which is 5.46% higher than the ResNet50 model. Furthermore, the two-stage transfer algorithm can further improve the recognition accuracy to 90.64%.

articleTitle: Polyp Segmentation Neural Network with Simple Encoding Structure and Reverse Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Colorectal cancer is a common malignancy. In colonoscopy images, computer-assisted polyp segmentation helps doctors diagnose and treat disorders more precisely. In recent years, some methods based on deep convolutional neural networks have made significant breakthroughs in this task. However, only a few algorithms explicitly consider the effect of light intensity on segmentation performance, which results in algorithms needing to be more robust for complex samples. This paper proposes a neural network combining a simple encoding structure with a reverse attention module. Specifically, the model uses HarDNet68 as the backbone network, adds a camouflage identification module (CIM) to enhance the capture of polyp details on the underlying features, and finally utilizes adaptive feature fusion with the reverse attention module (RAM). The proposed model effectively addresses the challenge of poor segmentation quality in colonoscopy images caused by inconsistent illumination. Extensive experiments on five datasets show that the proposed model performs well in polyp segmentation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Construction of New Teaching Materials for Arts and Physical Education in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article, setting against the backdrop of the modern sociocultural environment and focusing on the study of physical education teaching materials in vocational colleges, elaborates on the task of developing new forms of teaching materials in response to the current development status of arts and physical education programs in higher vocational colleges. The development and application of new forms of teaching materials in arts and physical education are imperative for higher vocational colleges to adapt to the evolving needs of the era. It is believed that well-designed new teaching materials will undoubtedly help students in arts and physical education programs in vocational colleges excel.

articleTitle: Prediction of College Students' Learning Quality Based on Machine Learning Under the Background of Digital Education*
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By analyzing the characteristics of different types of courses, the evaluation items with strong correlation in the data of procedural learning behavior are selected as the characteristic values, and high-quality data sets are established. Combined with typical machine learning algorithms, a predictive model of learning quality is constructed to evaluate the effect and quality of students' learning and guide the improvement of the teaching process. The experiment shows that the achievement prediction system built has a high accuracy rate, which has certain reference value for helping teachers effectively identify the objects of concern, so as to timely warn and intervene in the learning of disadvantaged students, guide the mixed teaching in a targeted way, optimize the teaching design, and improve the overall quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Instance-Aware Data Augmentation for Unsupervised Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Unsupervised person re-identification (Re-D) methods have made significant advances through comparative learning using unlabeled data. However, previous methods, including cluster-level or instance-level contrast loss, did not fully explore the inherent commonality of each identified individual in unlabeled samples, and also ignored the variation between samples within the class, where differences in individual clusters and convergence of different clusters lead to a set of noisy pseudo-labels, which may lead to the accumulation of label noise. In order to solve this problem, We use GAN to enrich the diversity of samples to alleviate the interference of intra-class variations and inter-class similarity.By switching the appearance of images, the generation module can reconstruct pedestrian images and then improve the discrimination module by using these images. Therefore, the framework proposed in this paper also achieves good performance in existing data sets.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Following Driving System Based on MSP432P401R
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As a key research topic in the field of intelligent vehicle system, path follow control includes odometry, obstacle detection, path planning, and path tracking, has attracting significant attention from scholars. In this paper, we utilize the MSP432P401R micro controller as the development platform to build an embedded hardware control system. The system comprises the K210Dock, OpenMv camera module, Bluetooth serial communication module, power module, motor driver module, and interface circuit design between modules. By incorporating the position PID algorithm, the system achieves differential speed rotation for the two driving wheels of the vehicle, enabling autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and path tracking. By simulating real vehicle driving conditions, this study provides valuable insights for the research on intelligent vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Water-Rescue Life Jacket System Based on Satellite Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In response to safety hazards faced by maritime enthusiasts and workers, and in order to reduce the occurrence of maritime accidents, this paper presents the design of an intelligent waterborne life jacket system based on satellite positioning. A multifunctional smart life jacket for maritime rescue is designed in this paper. This novel life jacket consists primarily of two components: the client-side (life jacket) and the mobile phone-side. In the complex external environment of the deep sea, once the client-side life jacket is activated, it can promptly send location signals via a GPS communication module. The server-side where rescue personnel are located receives the distress signal and transmits the rescuer's location information to the rescuer's mobile terminal through an app. The mobile terminal then uses its satellite navigation positioning system to pinpoint the location, enabling rescuers to quickly locate the stranded individual along the navigation route. Experimental test results demonstrate that the system, through embedded devices, can accurately monitor the location and relevant information of a person in distress, achieving the goal of remote monitoring and alarm. This research holds significance for the safety of waterborne workers and the control of maritime accident rates.

articleTitle: Personalized International Chinese Education based on ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the role of ChatGPT in personalized international Chinese teaching, this paper explores how ChatGPT can be integrated into personalized international Chinese education from the perspectives of both students and teachers. Afterward, personalized writing instruction was used as an example to demonstrate the specific methods and operational steps of integrating ChatGPT into teaching. The teaching effectiveness was then evaluated quantitatively through test results and a user experience investigation. It is found that the group using ChatGPT has higher achievement and students' attitudes towards using ChatGPT are overall more positive. This empirical study can well support the contribution of ChatGPT in personalized teaching.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Advancements in Medicine and Education: A Pilot Study on AI-Assisted Diagnosis and Treatment for Blood Coagulation Disorder
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic underscores the need for efficient coagulation monitoring. This study presents a pilot integrated platform using big data and AI technology to streamline coagulation procedures. Leveraging 765 samples, we built a data collection system capturing coagulation, metabolism, blood gas, and osmotic pressure indicators. AI identified data features and disease symptom importance, resulting in a robust disease model database. An intelligent decision-making system for abnormal coagulation was constructed. Our findings show improved diagnosis efficiency and accuracy, forming a foundation for precision medicine. This intelligent intervention system aligns with personalized evidence-based diagnosis and treatment, promising more accurate clinical outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Early Warning of University Budget Expenditure Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data and artificial intelligence, the internal management of colleges and universities is also constantly advancing from the traditional management mode to the intelligent management. A large amount of financial and business data accumulated by the financial cloud system can be used to realize intelligent early warning of financial expenses, which helps financial managers and financial personnel timely discover the dangers existing in the expenditure control of the unit, and is of great significance for further strengthening the expenditure control of colleges and universities and promoting the informatization construction of internal control. This paper uses the method of machine learning to design an intelligent early warning framework for budget expenditure control in colleges and universities, and uses the K-means clustering algorithm to design an early warning method for the integrity control of college expenditure approval process. The early warning data is classified into unsupervised clusters and early warning levels of various data to achieve early warning for the integrity control of college expenditure approval process.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Strategy of Three-Dimensional Model Printing Process for Electrical Equipments
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article analyzes the current status and main problems of using three-dimensional (3D) printing technology to complete electrical equipment model printing in the power industry. We analyze the main reasons for the low success rate of 3D model printing and propose solutions for process optimization, in order to better meet the higher requirements of shortening the work cycle, saving costs, and improving processes in the equipment development process, thereby improving the quality and efficiency of electrical equipment planning and design. With the aim of using 3D printing technology to better serve the development and visualization of equipment, promote the visualization of power grid planning, and empower the intelligence of the power industry.

articleTitle: Kernel-Guided Texture-Aware Blind Super-Resolution via Uncertainty Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The accuracy of kernel estimation is critical to the performance of blind super-resolution (SR). Traditional kernel estimation methods usually use L1 or L2 loss function to minimize the difference between the estimated kernel and the ground-truth kernel. This tends to make the estimated kernel converge towards the average of all possible kernels, deviating from the ground-truth kernel. To improve the performance of kernel estimation, this paper proposes an uncertainty loss for training a kernel estimation network, focusing on regions with high uncertainty (variance) in the kernel. In addition, a texture-aware SR network is proposed that utilizes the Gumbel Softmax trick to pay more attention to the complex regions of the image texture, thus improving the SR performance. Extensive experiments on synthetic datasets show that our approach achieves promising performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Feature Selection Based on Improved Fisher Score with Label Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Feature selection for multi-label classification has received extensive attention in the fields of machine learning and data mining. However, some feature selection methods fail to incorporate label correlations, resulting in the degradation of learning performance. In this paper, we dedicate to fuse the Fisher score model and neighborhood mutual information model for multi-label learning. The neighborhood mutual information is initially constructed to identify the coefficients between labels, by measuring the granularity of each instance. After that, an improved Fisher score model based on label coefficients is formed to select features with multiple crucial labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Exploration of Computer-Based Programming in the Clinical Application of Traditional Chinese Medicine's Five-Element Music Therapy
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The clinical application of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Five-Element music therapy has achieved certain results in the treatment of physical and mental diseases. However, there are still issues such as limited song choices, unclear tonic modes, and neglect of individual differences among patients in selecting appropriate music. This article explores the feasibility and clinical application of computer-based programming for the Five-Element music, aiming to enhance clinical intervention through more diverse and standardized Five-Element music therapy. By utilizing computer technology, it becomes possible to compose music with different rhythms, styles, and emotional expressions within each tonic mode, thus promoting personalized treatment in TCM Five-Element music therapy.

articleTitle: Label Distribution Learning Based on Two-stage Model Error Repair Method
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Label distribution learning (LDL) is a new learning paradigm proposed in the field of machine learning to solve the problem of label ambiguity. Many existing label distribution learning algorithms only consider the simple relationship between labels and do not mine out the complex relationship between labels. To address this problem, this paper proposes a label distribution learning based on a two-stage model error repair method(LDL-TERM). First, the initial model is used to predict the training set, and its prediction results are used as additional Features are integrated into the LDL-TER model; secondly, norm regularization is used to control the relative importance between the additional feature set and the original feature set. Experiments on 14 related data sets prove that the algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: A Method for Balanced Distribution of Key Parameters in Industrial Products Based on Multi-Objective Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to realize the fast and accurate distribution of various parameters such as components in the design of industrial products, a specific method based on multi-objective balanced distribution is proposed in this paper. By transforming industrial data into matrix data, the problem of balance stability in industrial design is solved scientifically and normally. The simulation results show that the proposed method can realize the expected function in different ways according to the size of the data.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Vision-Based Physical Fitness Test for College Students
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision technology, its application in various fields has become more and more extensive. Through the analysis of related research, it is found that computer vision can not only improve the efficiency and accuracy of physical fitness test in colleges and universities, but also further promote the development of physical education and the implementation of intelligent management. Taking the test of National Student Physical Fitness Standard as the background, this paper analyzes the application of computer vision in the physical fitness test of students in colleges and universities, including its role in the measurement and data processing of three parts, namely, body morphology, physical function and physical quality, explores how computer vision technology can properly utilize its potential and advantages in physical fitness testing of students in higher education and discusses its future development direction, with a view to providing reference for the development of sports informatization and digitalization in higher education.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Manhole Cover System Based on BeiDou Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the advent of the digital economy era, an increasing number of public infrastructure projects are moving towards smart, digital, and technological solutions. The number of city manhole covers is continuously increasing, but problems such as loss, damage, and displacement of these manhole covers frequently occur. Traditional manual inspections are unable to comprehensively monitor manhole cover information and address anomalies in a timely manner, which hampers urban management and poses threats to pedestrian safety.This project combines Internet of Things (IoT) technology with traditional manhole covers to develop smart manhole covers that can be remotely monitored. The system comprises a mobile application and intelligent manhole covers, with the latter equipped with functions such as sewer water level detection, harmful gas detection, BeiDou positioning, and manhole cover tilt angle detection. The STM32F103 chip uploads the detection data to an OLED display and a wireless communication module, and then uses UWB communication technology to transmit it to a server. The server performs big data analysis, processing, integration, and storage. The management platform acquires real-time manhole cover information, monitors real-time data, issues alerts based on the data, and ensures the timely handling of manhole cover and sewer anomalies, reducing harm to pedestrian safety and enhancing urban management and governance.

articleTitle: The Reform and Practice of College Computer Basic Courses Towards Computational Thinking and Empowerment Education Under the Background of New Liberal Arts
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research purpose of the article is to explore new ideas for the reform of university computer basic courses. The proposed method starts with the background of the construction of new liberal arts and the demand for computational thinking and empowerment education. It aims at the current teaching status of college computer basic courses in application-oriented local undergraduate universities, and deeply analyzes the new situation faced by the reform of college computer basic courses. The result is to explore the path and methods of computer basic course reform in liberal arts universities from three aspects: setting course modules, reconstructing teaching content, and reforming teaching methods. The conclusion is a new idea for the reform of computer basic courses in universities.

articleTitle: Innovation of Blended Learning Model Based on SPOC and Teachermate Platform for Applied Talent Training: With College Spoken English and Western Culture General Education Course as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Catering to the teaching reform of College English General Education course in the background of researching SPOC, this paper discusses the teaching mode of “online self-study learning + offline knowledge enhancement”, combining with Teachermate platform to carry out the blended teaching concept and course design, and applies it to the innovative practice of the blended learning model of College Spoken English and Western Culture General Education course. After a term's teaching practice, this paper conducts an empirical analysis on the teaching effect by using the statistical function of the platform. The results show that the blended learning model based on SPOC and Teachermate platform can provide students with diversified learning resources, meet their personalized learning needs, improve their learning self-efficacy, and facilitate the teaching effect of College Spoken English and Western Culture. It brings a brand-new and diversified interactive learning experience and improves students' comprehensive ability of using English. This study plays a positive role in the teaching model innovation of College English General Education course and the construction of school-based course.

articleTitle: Research on the State Identification Model Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To establish a state identification algorithm model using convolutional neural network model (CNN). Methods: Based on the fundamental principles of traditional Chinese medicine state identification, the study starts with state characterizations from medical cases and establishes a state characterization database. A CNN-based state element induction model (CNN-SEI) is constructed to connect the state characterizations to state elements and to identify states. Results: The model exhibits significant advantages in accuracy and recall rates, and the results of state identification are highly consistent with clinical diagnosis. Conclusion: This algorithm can improve the accuracy of state identification and provide guidance for clinical syndrome differentiation.

articleTitle: Research on User Behavior Pattern Classification Based on Probabilistic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The energy consumption of a building is usually influenced by its physical properties and occupant behavior. Due to the lifestyle, preference, occupation and other factors of the occupants, the behavior pattern and time arrangement of the occupants of each building may be different, and the behavior and living status of the occupants have a significant impact on the change of energy consumption. There is a lack of relevant studies that combine the activity patterns of occupants and the energy consumption patterns of buildings in previous work. In this paper, occupant behavior patterns and energy consumption patterns are analyzed in depth. The machine learning method is used to classify user behavior patterns based on probabilistic neural network, and the model fusion and data fusion methods are used to mine the matching relationship between occupant activity patterns and energy consumption patterns. Through the classification of the behavior patterns of the occupants and the results of the simulation, the energy demand of the occupants can be estimated accordingly. Based on these issues, the aim of this paper is to find a new approach to assess building energy demand and consumption on the basis of time usage data (TUD) to identify and analyze occupant behavior.

articleTitle: A Study on the Incentives of Scientific Research and Social Services for University Teachers Under the Multi-task Principal-Agent Relationship
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research on measures to motivate teachers to conduct scientific research and provide social services in colleges and universities can better improve the efficiency of education. By establishing the benefit function of colleges and universities and the effort function of teachers, a multitask principal-agent model can be established, and the model can be solved using nonlinear function solving methods. By designing incentive contracts for university teachers, the relative incentive intensity has been obtained, and the impact of various influencing factors on the relative incentive intensity has been analyzed. The conclusion has been drawn that improving scientific research output is more difficult and uncertain compared to social services, and colleges and universities should appropriately reduce the incentive ratio in scientific research.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimization of the Curriculum System of Electrical Engineering and Automation Majors in the Context of “Dual Carbon Goal”
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper outlines a curriculum optimization plan for electrical engineering and automation at Shandong University of Science and Technology, aligning with the “dual carbon goal” and new power system requirements. Focused on “new energy + digital intelligence,” it designs a knowledge framework in response to the characteristics of these power systems. The plan integrates national teaching quality standards, discussing alignment and division between Chinese and foreign courses. It defines curriculum, adjusts specialized content, and forms a multidisciplinary teaching team using “three integrations and three combinations.” Moreover, AI, including emotion recognition, aids classroom instruction. This program was applied from 2018 to 2022, with student feedback highlighting rich content, effective teaching, and improved professional competence.

articleTitle: Interpreting Learner Success: Enhancing Knowledge Tracing with Attention-Based IRT Models in Modern Education
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the past few decades, Computer-Assisted Education Systems (CAES) have experienced rapid development. These platforms can recommend adaptive learning materials, conduct knowledge tests, offer learning path suggestions, and create personalized study plans for learners. Knowledge tracing (KT) is a fundamental task in the field of artificial intelligence education. It involves the estimation of students' knowledge levels based on the likelihood of their correct responses to questions, allowing the prediction of their future performance. In recent years, it has gained significant attention due to its importance in subsequent tasks such as organizing learning materials. However, previous knowledge tracing models have struggled to simultaneously enhance interpretability and predictive accuracy. In this paper, we propose a knowledge tracing model based on attention mechanisms. This model establishes connections between the current problem and each past question the learner has answered, embedding a simple and interpretable Item Response Theory (IRT) model to capture individual differences between questions. Our extensive experiments, conducted on five benchmark datasets (Statics2011, ASSISTments2009, ASSISTments2015, Algebra06 and Slepemapy), demonstrate significant improvements in our model compared to previous knowledge tracing methods. Further analysis illustrates how our method improves the interpretive aspects of knowledge tracing, signifying its enhanced applicability in practical educational contexts.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Scaffolding Teaching Model in Middle School Mathematics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The new standard emphasizes that students should actively participate in classroom activities, focusing on cultivating students' ability of independent inquiry and cooperative learning, developing core literacy and improving comprehensive quality. As a result, the traditional teaching mode is not enough to meet the requirements of the new standards for teaching. Therefore, this paper applies the scaffolding teaching model developed on the basis of constructivist theory to the teaching activities of middle school mathematics. In this paper, we will take “the image and properties of quadratic functions, the second lesson” as an example, based on this model for teaching design. It tries to provide a way of thinking about math teaching and improving the efficiency of teaching.

articleTitle: Abortive Transcripts can be Used as Plasma Biomarkers of Acute Liver Injury
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Abortive transcripts (ATs) refer to short nascent RNA released by RNA polymerase before the synthesis of productive RNA. Compared with productive RNAs, AT has the characteristics of low molecular weight (2–10 nt), wide variety, and abundant content, making it a potential biomarkers. Here, the base stacking hybridization assisted ligation (BSHAL) technique and TaqMan-MGB qPCR were be used to analysis the plasma levels of fourteen 8 nt ATs in normal and acute liver injury mice. It was found that all these ATs were detectable, with six showing significant differences between mouse groups, demonstrating that ATs are promising biomarkers in plasma.

Author Keywords: base stacking hybridization assisted ligation technique (BSHAL)

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Virtual Simulation System for Computer Assembly and Maintenance Course in Vocational School
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the advancement of education digital transformation, research on the design of virtual simulation systems and their application as teaching tools has become increasingly important both domestically and internationally. This paper takes the computer assembly and maintenance courses in vocational school as an example, utilizing 3D Max for modeling and constructing a virtual simulation system based on the Unity 3D platform. This system can help students get familiar with computer assembly and maintenance through virtual operations, and reduce the equipment loss caused by misoperation in the actual course. Incorporating demonstration, scenario-based teaching, and project-based teaching methods, this paper effectively integrates information technology into the teaching process to enhance students' interest and initiative in learning.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Mechanical Design and Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the wide application and popularization of artificial intelligence technology in the field of mechanical design and manufacturing, its unique advantages and roles have become more obvious, promoting the profound transformation and development of the mechanical design and manufacturing industry. Based on the analysis of the positive role of AI technology in mechanical design and manufacturing, this paper discusses the application of AI in mechanical design and manufacturing, highlighting its important role in improving efficiency, reducing costs, guaranteeing quality and promoting digital transformation, which provides an important reference for the development of the industry.

articleTitle: PDCapsNet: A Convolution Neural Network Method for COVID-19 Detection from Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic started in 2019 and it is still important to develop intelligent and efficient diagnostic methods for the detection of COVID-19. In the task of COVID-19 X-ray image recognition, conventional deep neural networks encounter challenges in effectively discerning distinctive features within pneumonia images, resulting in limited generalization capability when confronted with novel samples. To address this issue, we introduce a novel model in this paper, denoted as PDCapsNet. The model effectively exploits Pyconv's multi-scale fusion technique and leverages the capsule network's capacity to encapsulate diverse attributes of specific entities within COVID-19 X-ray images, resulting in enhancements in both accuracy and generalization. Experimental results show that the proposed model outperforms other previous related works.

articleTitle: Exploration on Ideological and Political Teaching in Real Variable Function Course
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Comprehensively promoting curriculum ideological and political construction is a strategic measure to carry out the fundamental task of moral education, it is also an important task to improve the quality of talent training. Real variable function is a professional extension course for mathematics majors in colleges and universities, it is necessary to carry out ideological and political teaching in curriculum. Firstly, this paper analyzes the significance of implementing curriculum ideology and politics in real variable function course, then combine the characteristics of the course, from the characteristics of teaching materials, teaching content, teaching methods and so on, this paper gives the concrete measures of implementing curriculum thinking and politics in the classroom of real variable function.

articleTitle: Legal Risks and Governance Paths for Generative AI--A Case Study of ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The release of OpenAI's ChatGPT chatbot has sparked widespread concern around the world about the threats and legal issues of generative AI. Although this technological innovation has opened a new chapter in the field of artificial intelligence, it has also caused the public to worry about its possible negative effects. In order to solve the above problems and reasonably regulate the legal risks of generative artificial intelligence, this paper mainly adopts the literature, quantitative and qualitative analysis methods, etc. The first part mainly introduces the development process and current situation of generative artificial intelligence, the second part mainly discusses the impact of generative artificial intelligence on tort law, the third part mainly discusses the legal risks of generative artificial intelligence, and the fourth part mainly discusses the governance path of generative artificial intelligence legal risks. The last part is the conclusion of the research. Among them, the fourth part is the focus of this paper. By taking these issues into account, we can provide legal guarantees for the sustainable development of the generative AI industry and ensure that the widespread application of AI benefits human society[1].

articleTitle: A Syntax-directed Voice-activated Programming Environment for Java
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Coding by voice is an attractive approach for software engineers who suffer from repetitive strain injury, and quite a few work have been done. Most of existing approaches merely provide a speech recognition surface that simply translates program fragment from voice to text. We try to solve this problem from a new perspective by implementing a voice-activated pro-gramming environment based on VSCode. What is more, a Java program is constructed in a syntax-directed manner through a sequence of carefully designed commands recognized from voice, which is different from traditional text-based approach. User does not need to dictate spaces, parentheses, and commas as text-based approach any more which reduces vocal load and syntax errors.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Function Optimization Based on Biological Models Sparing the Dose of Organs at Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Compared with IMRT treatment technology, IMAT can produce a high dose gradient around the target area, thereby improving the conformity of the target area and reducing the high-dose irradiation volume, but it will increase the low-dose irradiation area of the surrounding OAR. The increased volume of low-dose irradiation of organs at risk could increase the side effects of radiotherapy and induce secondary canceration. Elekta Monaco(v5.1) treatment planning system provides multi-criteria optimization based on Pareto Front function optimization, which is effective in improving the equivalent uniform dose and tumor control rate in the target area and protecting organs tissue. The aim of this paper intended to use Pareto Front multi-objective function to study the sensitivity function of the target dose to the surrounding OAR during a conventional linear accelerator delivering in IMAT, analyzing the trade-off between the target dose and the OAR dose of the IMAT plan optimization parameters, and valiated the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Multi-Cryptosystem Supported Authentication Scheme for Internet of Medical Things
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Nowadays, the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) is playing an increasingly important role in maintaining people's daily health. IoMT devices generate a great amount of data that could be used for different applications such as data analysis. Due to the untrusted nature of machine-to-machine (M2M) communication channels, data authenticity is an important issue that must be addressed. Especially, it is challenging to deal with the privacy disclosure which the heterogeneity of IoMT brings about. In this paper, we propose a multi-cryptosystem supported scheme for authenticity in IoMT systems. Our authentication schemes support many kinds of IoMT devices with multi-cryptographic configurations such as RSA-based, DL-based, ECC-based, and Lattice-based cryptosystems. We provide the formalized proof of the unforgeability and privacy of the proposed schemes in the random oracle model. The experimental simulation demonstrates that the proposed schemes are feasible in the heterogeneous IoMT environment.

articleTitle: Context Matters: Advancing Knowledge Tracing in Online Learning with Enhanced Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Online learning platforms are widely used in the field of education and are popular for their ability to personalize learning plans based on students' individual needs and learning history. Knowledge tracking is an important task in the field of education, which aims to monitor students' learning progress and knowledge mastery. Traditional knowledge tracking methods mainly track students' knowledge state based on individual historical information, but often ignore the contextual information in the learning process of students, that is, the impact of recent similar learning experiences on the prediction accuracy of students' answers. Therefore, we propose enhanced knowledge tracing for online learning based on attention mechanisms, which can effectively use attention mechanisms to improve the performance of knowledge tracing models. First, we introduce parallel attention mechanism that adjusts its attention to different contextual information to better capture the impact of the latest relevant practices. Secondly, considering the influence of different factors can evaluate students' knowledge status more comprehensively and reduce the bias of single factor. The effectiveness of our proposed method is demonstrated by experiments on four real data sets, and the experimental results show that our method has the best performance.

articleTitle: Fire Detection Based on Improved Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Fire is a serious disaster that endangers life and property worldwide. Accurate and prompt fire detection can provide early warning information for firefighting efforts. Deep learning-based object detection algorithms have proven to be useful in the field of fire detection. However, fire detection is a particularly challenging task, due to the low-resolution of fire images and the presence of blurring and deformation in the targets. Existing fire detection methods are limited by poor detection accuracy and slow speed in complex fire scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a fire detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5s. Firstly, the attention module is embedded into the network structure. We introduce this attention module into the last layer of the backbone to enhance feature extraction ability. Secondly, we modify the Neck structure to fully fuse different feature maps. Through fusing extra low-level features from the backbone, it utilizes various receptive fields to enhance the expression of feature. Thirdly, SIoU is introduced to achieve faster convergence during the training. SIoU take into account the direction of the mismatch to redefine penalty indicators. The experimental results show that our proposed algorithm outperforms commonly used models. Even compared to specific fire detectors, our model exhibits certain advantages.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effect of Application Navigation of Information Portal System: A Combined System Design Analysis and Real-System Log Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Evaluating the navigation effect of an information system is of great significance for improving application design and user experience. This paper proposes a method to measure the efficiency of information navigation, establishes a calculation model of user operation costs based on actual user usage data, and comprehensively and quantitatively evaluates various information navigation methods in the system. This paper evaluates and measures the campus application navigation on the new version and the old version of the information portal system of Tsinghua University, and the evaluated theoretical cost of accessing a campus application from the new system is reduced to 62.1%, and the measured time cost in fact reduced to less than 6.2%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Investment Value of Traditional Chinese Medicine Enterprises Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Whether a company has investment value and how to measure its investment value are the primary concerns of every investor. Effectively evaluating the investment value of a company can not only help the company recognize its own problems and value, achieve faster growth, but also help investors obtain more investment returns. This study selects 9 traditional Chinese medicine enterprises listed in Yunnan and Guizhou provinces as the research objects, and constructs an evaluation model based on projection pursuit model using four indicators of enterprise growth, profitability, revenue quality, and operational ability. Genetic algorithm is used to solve for the optimal projection value, and a comprehensive and objective evaluation model for the investment value of traditional Chinese medicine enterprises is established. The analysis found that among the four indicators that affect the investment value of traditional Chinese medicine enterprises, the weight of profitability indicator is 0.393, the weight of growth indicator is 0.215, the weight of operation indicator is 0.213, and the weight of return quality indicator is 0.179. Among the secondary indicators, the highest weight is total asset turnover rate, followed by net operating cash flow/total operating income, which are 0.202 and 0.158, respectively. Investors can consider these indicators comprehensively in the investment process to select investment targets; Traditional Chinese medicine enterprises can strengthen their capabilities in related fields, enhance their own value, and attract more investment.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Automatic Detection System for Moment of Inertia
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of the traditional torsion pendulum method to measure the moment of inertia, a moment of inertia measurement system of STC89C52 Single-Chip Microcomputer(SCM) and photoelectric pair tube was researched and produced Value, the SCM is used as the control core, and the measured value of the moment of inertia is directly calculated and displayed in conjunction with the liquid crystal display. NRF24101 as a wireless control module can realize remote monitoring. Compared with traditional measuring devices, the system has the advantages of high accuracy, simple operation and small size, avoiding complicated calculations, reducing errors of human calculations, realizing remote real-time monitoring, automating the measurement process, and greatly improving the measurements efficiency.

articleTitle: Dual AxAtGAN: A Feature Intregrate BCI Model for Image Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The visual stimulus-oriented brain activity reconstruction method based on BCI technology has the advantages of high transmission rate and easy operation. However, the problem of losing feature information due to vector dimensionality reduction still exists in existing visual evoked EEG reconstruction algorithms. This motivates us to design an end-to-end model, Dual AxAtGAN, where the network is nested using two Dual GAN as the basic framework, which is able to directly perform the task of reconstructing from video-evoked EEG to the corresponding video. In addition, existing reconstruction algorithms are based on convolutional neural networks, which can only focus on a local subset of a pixel point in an image, and leads to the model's lack of understanding of the long-range dependence of the EEG signal features, and consequently it is unable to reconstruct the corresponding image or video. To address the above challenges, inspired by the transformer block, we modified the axial multi-head self-attention module instead of the CNN blocks, which improves the model's understanding of the long-range dependence of EEG signals. In addition, we train the data from two branches, global and local, which in turn improves the performance of the model, and finally reconstruct the videos corresponding to the evoked EEG. To test the reconstruction effect of the model, we design a supervised paradigm that meets the requirements of this experiment to obtain the dataset of video-evoked EEG. Compared with the existing methods, our proposed model can better perform the task of video-evoked EEG reconstruction.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual Vehicle Following Driving System Based on EXP430F5529LP
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By collecting road surface information through OpenMV cameras, MSP-EXP430F5529LP is used as the control core to process the data collected by OpenMV. The encoding motor is used as the driving module, OLED is used to display information, Bluetooth module is used for communication between two workshops, and ultrasonic wave module is used to monitor the distance between two vehicles. Therefore, a small vehicle following driving system based on MSP-EXP430F5529LP microcontroller is designed. The entire system mainly consists of an MSP-EXP430F5529LP development board, TB6612 motor driver module, ultrasonic module, OLED display module, Bluetooth module, encoding motor, and camera.

articleTitle: The Strategy Research of Junior High School Mathematics Homework Design Under the Core Literacy
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: How to cultivate and develop students' core literacy has always been a hot topic in the education circle.
