With the implementation of the “double reduction” policy and the promulgation of the compulsory education mathematics curriculum standards, the majority of education researchers began to pay attention to the development of students' core literacy in the process of completing their homework, so the homework design under the core literacy is very important. Through consulting relevant data and investigation, this paper found that there are some problems in the design of junior high school math homework, such as teachers' lack of awareness of integrating core literacy, single form of homework, lack of hierarchy of homework, and lack of close contact with life. In view of the above problems, at the theoretical level, teachers can follow the principles of goal, hierarchy, thinking, diversity to design homework. At the practical level, teachers should establish a core quality-oriented view of homework, use the core literacy theory to design unit homework, design layered homework and enrich the types of homework, and strengthen the connection with real life. Through the above strategies to develop students' key abilities, cultivate the sense of application and innovation, to provide a reference for the majority of front-line teachers in junior middle school math homework design.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Method Based on ART2 Dynamic Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the extreme sparsity of user rating dat a in collaborative filtering recommendations and the recomme ndation problem for new users, this paper constructs a persona l feature matrix for users by collecting user registration inform ation. It adopts the ART2 neural network dynamic clustering a lgorithm along with the user's personal feature matrix to classi fy users, find neighboring users for the target user, predict rati ngs for unrated items, and improve the response time and accu racy of online recommendations. Experimental results demonst rate that the improved algorithm significantly enhances the rec ommendation quality of the recommendation system, especiall y in situations where user rating data is extremely sparse. Addi tionally, the algorithm effectively addresses the recommendatio n problem for new items.

articleTitle: Design of a Virtual Simulation Experimental Teaching Platform Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The virtual simulation experiment teaching system based on the Internet of Things simulates the Internet of Things sensing device in the form of software, and integrates relatively new teaching methods and theoretical knowledge, designs and completes a characteristic, can adapt to various needs of the Internet of Things experiment teaching system, and strives to provide more efficient protection and help for teachers' teaching tasks and students' learning tasks. To a large extent, it can solve the problems in the design and implementation of the Internet of Things application system, provide students with practical operation opportunities in the way of virtual simulation, combine theory and practice, and cultivate application-oriented talents urgently needed by the industry.

articleTitle: Analysis of Anti-Aging Chinese Medicine Prescriptions: A Comparison of Data Mining Between Song Dynasty and Modern Formulation Patterns
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Data mining techniques were used to compare and analyze the herbal compositions of anti-aging Chinese medicine prescription in Chinese Song Dynasty and modern literature and analyze the potential patterns. Methods: 222 anti-aging formulas were screened and included from the three major officially revised prescription works of the Song Dynasty, namely, Taiping Shenghui Fang, Shengji Zonglu, and Taiping Huimin Hejiaobu Fang, according to the nanoexclusion criteria. 68 modern anti-aging prescriptions were screened for inclusion. Frequency statistics were performed using Microsoft Excel 2020, and association rules were analyzed using SPSS Modeler to construct herbal association network diagrams. Results: Frequency analysis of 222 Song Dynasty formulas and 68 modern formulas revealed that Song Dynasty herbals were used in the top 3: indian bread, honey, Cassia bark. Modern herbals used in the top 3 were: Prepared rehmannia root, indian bread, ginseng. The high-frequency uses of herbs in Song Dynasty and modern terminology are: indian bread, prepared rehmannia root, ginseng, Chinese yam, desertliving cistanche \, twotoothed achyranthes root, and core herbal pairs were discovered by association rules. Conclusion: The use of some herbs appeared to be different in ancient and modern terms, but in both Song and modern terms, in anti-aging, the dispensations emphasized the importance of tonifying the kidneys. In addition, the high-frequency use of herbals were mostly warm, flat, and moisturizing and nourishing, form and spirit, and yin and yang, which provided inspiration into the research and development of new formulas.

articleTitle: Enhancing Clinical Practice Teaching through the Application of Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, the research and application of virtual reality (VR) technology have gained significant momentum. As society and technology continue to advance and individuals become more health-conscious, an increasing number of researchers have turned their attention to computer-aided clinical teaching. Computer-aided teaching, facilitated by VR technology, is poised to become a potent tool for enhancing clinical skills training. This paper explores the unique characteristics of clinical practice teaching in medical institutions, delves into the comprehensive design and functionality of VR-assisted clinical practice teaching, and aims to replace traditional teaching methods with VR technology. By doing so, it seeks to provide personalized guidance to participants involved in clinical practice teaching. The integration of VR technology into conventional clinical practice teaching holds the potential to significantly improve learners' practical skills and should not be underestimated in its future development.

articleTitle: Research on VR Medical Surgery Training System with Multi-User Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Virtual reality and internet communication technology have developed rapidly, and medical surgery training systems based on virtual reality have gradually matured, generating many new demands. A multi-user collaborative framework design is proposed to address the shortcomings of most medical surgery training systems that can only achieve single user operations, in order to meet the needs of collaborative training in virtual reality teaching processes. Based on the characteristics of medical surgery, a multi-user collaborative simulation surgery training system for laparoscopic cholecystectomy was implemented through frame synchronization of object positions and shared events. Finally, comparative testing and analysis were conducted on various aspects such as usage effectiveness and operational performance, indicating that the system has good performance and improves the learning effectiveness of trainers.

articleTitle: Medical Relationship Classification Method Based on Dual Channel Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Electronic medical record mining based on relationship classification has become a hot topic in the field of healthcare. However, in existing models of relationship classification, most of them use single-layer attention, it results in relatively simple feature representation and it is easy to lose information during training. Therefore, this paper proposes a medical relationship classification method based on dual channel attention. Firstly, channel 1 combines BERT(Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers), GRU(Gate Recurrent Unit) and Global Attention, while channel 2 combines Subject_object_mask_generation and So Attention. Specifically, we use Subject_object_mask_generation module to specify the corresponding positions of the subject and object within the text. And So Attention is used to focus on the attention between subject and object. Secondly, the outputs from the two channels are concatenated. Finally, we perform relationship classification on the concatenated results. We evaluated the method on the public dataset CMeIE(Chinese Medical Information Extraction), the experimental results showed that the improved model's accuracy, recall and F1 values are increased by 2.2%, 0.03% and 1.3% respectively, compared to the baseline. It indicates that our method has certain advantages compared to other relationship classification methods.

articleTitle: Cultural Inheritance and Value Reproduction: The Application of Intangible Cultural Heritage Clothing in Performance Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Intangible cultural heritage clothing refers to clothing in intangible cultural heritage, which is an important component of traditional Chinese culture. Intangible cultural heritage clothing includes various traditional clothing, such as Han clothing, Tibetan clothing, Mongolian clothing, opera clothing, and so on. In clothing performance teaching, intangible cultural heritage clothing is introduced as an educational resource into clothing performance teaching in universities. By systematically introducing the historical evolution of various traditional intangible cultural heritage clothing and refining its aesthetic value, it can help college students better understand Chinese traditional culture and enhance cultural confidence. At the same time, intangible cultural heritage clothing can also serve as a cultural heritage, inheriting and promoting the excellent traditional culture of the Chinese nation, and reproducing the educational value of traditional clothing culture.

articleTitle: Pulmonary X-Ray Image Classification Using Deep Learning with Coordinate Attention and Meta-ACON Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Pneumonia is a serious health risk that usually examined by lung X-rays. Traditional deep learning models neglect image location information, fail to establish long-range dependencies and the limited ability to handle pneumonia features. In this paper, we propose MCANet model based on ResNet50 architecture by combining coordinate attention module and introducing a new activation function (Meta-ACON). The coordinate attention module in this model is used to capture positional information and establish long-range dependencies on feature maps. Meta-ACON activation function can adaptively select whether each neuron is activated, which contributes to dynamically handling pneumonia features. This paper performs comparison experiments on the public dataset ChestXray2020. Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score are used as evaluation metrics. Experiment results show that the MCANet improves each metrics compared with the original ResNet50 by 4.14%, 3.63%,4.25% and 3.99% respectively.

articleTitle: Data Mining of Traditional Chinese Medicine for the Treatment of Pediatric Enuresis
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze the internal compound prescriptions recorded in the published literature on the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) treatment of pediatric enuresis to explore the medication rule of TCM prescriptions for treating pediatric enuresis and to further improve the therapeutic efficacy of TCM in treating pediatric enuresis. METHODS: We searched TCM clinical trial literature on pediatric enuresis published in The China National Knowledge Infrastructure (Cnki), the Wanfang database, and China Science and Technology Journal Database from the establishment of the databases to December 31, 2022. Data were extracted from the retrieved literature and entered into an Excel table. TCM properites, tastes, channel tropism, frequency of use, and efficacies were analyzed using SPSS 22.0 and SPSS Modeler 18.0 software. Cytoscape 3.8.0 software was used to make an association rule diagram. RESULTS: A total of 135 articles and 147 prescriptions were extracted from the literature, involving 135 types of Chinese herbal medicines with a total frequency of 1550 uses. The four qi and five tastes of them used most were sweet and warm; the channel tropism were mostly attributed to the kidney, spleen, and lung, and the efficacies were mostly based on astringent, qi tonic, and yang tonic effects. The herbs used most frequently were YI ZHI and SANG ZHI. CONCLUSION: The first choice of TCM for treating pediatric enuresis was those with mostly warm and flat medicinal properties; mainly sweet and pungent tasts; whose channel tropism were the kidney, spleen, and lung; and whose effects were astringent, qi tonic, and yang tonic.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Online and Offline Hybrid First-class Course Construction in Discrete Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Discrete Mathematics is a required course for the specialty of Data Science and Big Data Technology, and has an important position in the curriculum system of the specialty. By clarifying the teaching objectives of Discrete Mathematics course, analyzing the current pain point problems of Discrete Mathematics course, building an online teaching platform, implementing online and offline blended teaching, changing the course evaluation method and fully integrating the course Civics and Politics, we have achieved the purpose of improving the teaching effect and carrying out the construction of a first-class course of Discrete Mathematics.

articleTitle: The Educational Applications of Knowledge Graph in Python Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of educational informatization and the continuous progress of artificial intelligence technology, course knowledge graphs have gradually become a research hotspot in the field of education. The teaching process of Python courses faces the following problems: there are many knowledge points and difficulties in Python courses, a singular form of knowledge presentation, and teaching content that cannot meet the diverse learning needs of students. In response to these issues, this paper proposes the application of knowledge graphs in Python teaching. After one semester of practical implementation, students' learning efficiency and performance showed significant improvement.

articleTitle: The Research of Cel-Shading in Non-photorealistic Rendering
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper investigates the cel-shading based on universal render pipeline in Unity. Starting from the two main methods of cel-shading, namely outline and shading, this paper provides practice on outline, face shadow, cartoon shading, rim light, fur render, and gives the final results, exploring the suitable methods for cel-shading. Finally, this paper describes and concludes the current work, and proposes the methods to improve and work in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Content Reform of Data Structure for Data Science and Big data Technology Major
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to stimulate students' interest in learning, cultivate their practical ability and innovative awareness, and meet the demand for talent cultivation in data science and big data technology major, the main problems in the current teaching of data structure course were analyzed. Research was conducted on the optimization of course content from both theoretical and practical teaching perspectives. The main measures include introducing cases of using data structures in big data technology in theoretical teaching, adding comprehensive content with strong applicability in practical teaching, and establishing a multi-level practical teaching system. Practice has shown that the proposed reform method has effectively improved teaching effectiveness.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Construction of a Big Data Ecosphere for the Rural Elderly Health Promotion from the Perspective of Collaborative Governance
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In rural areas, the increasing health concerns of the elderly pose an increasing challenge. In addition, it is essential to understand operational dynamics, including creating a solid institutional framework, ensuring technical support and nurturing talent. A mechanism for continuous optimization through collaborative governance is also crucial. Experimental data shows that 97% of rural elderly aged 60 to 70, 95% aged 70 to 80, and 85% of those aged over 80 were satisfied with the ecosystem. In addition, 94% of nursing home employees surveyed expressed their satisfaction. This highlights the importance of collaborative multi-entity governance and a well-thought-out path to building a big data ecosystem that significantly improves the health of rural older people by combining big data technology and collaborative governance, providing a transformative solution for the health challenges faced by older people in rural areas.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Scaffolding for Computer Network Technology Based on Higher-Order Thinking Development
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents a case study on teaching support for the cultivation of higher-order thinking skills in the context of secondary vocational education, specifically in the field of computer network technology. The study aims to enhance students' higher-order thinking skills using the zone of proximal development and constructivism theory. It aims to address the specific characteristics and requirements of computer network technology. The article proposes designing scaffolding that targets five dimensions: ‘Analytical Ability’, ‘Comprehension Ability’, ‘Problem-Solving Ability’, ‘Evaluative Ability’, and ‘Creative Ability‘. The objective is to address the issue of shallow thinking among secondary vocational students. The article concludes by presenting a teaching scaffolding designed for the ‘Network Topology’ course in secondary vocational schools.

articleTitle: Metaverse Innovations in Education and Healthcare:: A Comprehensive Review and Future Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With technological advancements, the emerging field of the Metaverse, as a convergence of virtual and real, has drawn the attention of the education community. This research employs a systematic literature review to explore Metaverse classrooms, highlighting their potential benefits and design principles. Metaverse classrooms offer immersive learning experiences, fostering engagement and creativity, but pose challenges in technology and privacy. This study guides Metaverse classroom development and fosters educational innovation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Knowledge Extraction Tool for Teaching Video Based on Verbal Behavior Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology, tightly intertwined with the field of education, highlights the vast potential for leveraging AI in the analysis and assessment of teaching behavior. Verbal behaviors in teaching, as the primary way of knowledge transmission, has a direct and profound impact on teaching quality. However, existing researches in this domain focus on classroom environments and assessment of teaching effectiveness, and relatively little research has been conducted on the extraction of knowledge from teaching verbal behaviors. Researchers typically identify knowledge in teaching videos through manual observation and recording, a time-consuming and labor-intensive process that makes it challenging to extract knowledge from the extensive trove of teaching videos. In this paper, a knowledge extraction tool based on teaching video verbal behaviors was designed and implemented. It provides knowledge searching, positioning, and extracting functions, with a view to provide help for teaching researchers to analyze knowledge from the perspective of teaching verbal behavior. Additionally, it greatly improves the efficiency of extracting knowledge from teaching videos.

articleTitle: Effect of Acupuncture Treatment on Pediatric Tourette Syndrome: A Case Report
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Reason: In clinical treatment, Pediatric Tourette syndrome is primarily treated with Western medicine. The condition tends to relapse and can result in psychological, behavioral, and emotional difficulties for affected children. In this study, traditional Chinese acupuncture was used to treat a case of TS in a child, achieving satisfactory clinical efficacy. Patient concerns: The 11-year-old male patient became mentally tense 4 years ago due to parental scolding, and developed involuntary blinking, limb twitching, and subsequently experienced shoulder shrugging, sniffing, difficulties in concentration, and urinary incontinence.After undergoing assessments including the Neurobehavioral Examination and Yale Global Tic Severity Scale (YGTSS), he was diagnosed with Tourette syndrome and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. After treatment in Nanjing Children's Hospital, Children's Hospital Affiliated to Nanjing Medical University and other hospitals, he still did not improve. During the initial consultation at our hospital, the YGTSS score was 42, indicating a moderate level of tics. Symptoms included involuntary blinking, sniffing, limb twitching, and coprolalia. Diagnosis: In this study, the patient was diagnosed using a comprehensive assessment method that included biological marker testing and behavioral indicator testing. Interventions: Traditional Chinese acupuncture was Appli ed for treatment. Outcomes: After 3 treatments, the symptoms of blinking, sniffing, frowning, and limb twitching were improved. The frequency of episodes decreased, and the sleep condition was significantly improved. After 5 treatments, the child's involuntary movement symptoms had basically disappeared, no enuresis occurred, and his mood was good. The YGTSS score was 7 points, according to the YGTSS efficacy assessment criteria, a reduction rate greater than 60% indicates significant improvement. In this case, the reduction rate after 7 treatments was 83.3%. The symptoms were significantly controlled, and the patient's performance in school and social interactions improved. Conclusion: The clinical efficacy of acupuncture treatment for pediatric Tourette syndrome with coprolalia is remarka ble, indicating the need for further research in this area. Abbreviations: TS: Tourette's syndrome; TCM’ traditional Chinese medicine; YGTSS: Yale Comprehensive Tic Severity Scale; ADL: activities of daily living

articleTitle: TransCA: Transformer-Based Context Aggregator for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The diversity and complexity of medical images, as well as the problems such as boundary blurring, bring challenges to the segmentation task. However, the traditional mainstream methods are still faced with problems such as low accuracy and insufficient robustness to different types of images. Transformer and its variants have been widely used for medical image segmentation. However, its overall processing of input sequences makes it difficult for the model to focus on the relationship between different channels. To alleviate this problem, we propose a Transformer-based Context Aggregator Network. First, we use an encoder-decoder structure to extract feature representations of different levels. Secondly, we design a block Context Aggregator to improve the information extraction capability of the model in channel dimension. Finally, we introduce Context Aggregator into decoder and propose TransCA model. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our proposed model outperforms current advanced methods in the segmentation of skin lesion images and cell nucleus images. Furthermore, our approach exhibits greater robustness in various scenarios with blurred object boundaries and occlusions.

articleTitle: Image Texture Analysis Based on Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper studies the algorithm of Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM), explains the concrete meaning of 14 texture features based on GLCM, and points out the redundancy among texture features. Through the calculation and analysis of the gray level co-occurrence matrix of texture image and the experiments of texture feature extraction, it is shown that the gray level co-occurrence matrix can reflect the features of the image, and corresponds to the features of the image described by the texture features. At the same time, there is a certain degree of redundancy among the 14 texture features of the image. In practice, we can choose several prominent texture features to classify the image according to the difference of texture features. The analysis of texture features and experimental results are of great significance to the application of image texture features.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Teaching Systems in Experimental and Practical Teaching Based on CiteSpace Visual Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper investigates the utilization of virtual teaching systems in experimental and practical education, specifically focusing on enhancing the design and application of virtual teaching platforms in China. The CNKI database was utilized to search for relevant literature while CiteSpace was employed to conduct a visual analysis of the selected literature. The analysis includes the visualization of annual publication volume, keyword co-occurrence analysis, keywords clustering analysis, timeline analysis, and burst analysis. The results reveals primary research focuses and prominent topics in this field, and indicates that research interest in the application of virtual teaching platforms has significantly increased over the years, and at the same time, driven by technological progress and policy implementation, advances in virtual reality and 3D modeling technology provide theoretical support and opportunities for constructing more sophisticated educational platforms. Overall, this study provides valuable insights into the application of virtual teaching systems in experimental and practical teaching, contributing to the development of innovative educational approaches.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Enhanced DNA and ElGamal Cryptosystem for Secure Data Storage and Retrieval in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: DNA cryptography has been developed for nearly thirty years, and there is a lot of research on DNA based encryption and decryption. This article research purpose aims to analyze and explore of security of the Enhanced ElGamal algorithm in a paper titled “Enhanced DNA and ElGamal cryptosystem for secure data storage and retrieval in cloud” by Thangavel and Varlakshmi in 2018. In this paper the authors use mathematical proof and practical experience testing to prove their claim and viewpoint, those are our methods. For convenience, we implement the Enhanced ElGamal algorithm by HTML 5 language, observe each parameters status. Based on theoretical derivation and experimental proof, the results indicate Thangavel and Varlakshmi used don't care parameters <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{k_{1}}, \boldsymbol{k_{2}}$</tex> to produce <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{C_{2}}$</tex>. Thus, these three parameters are redundant, it makes an unnecessary move. In the same time, the authors conclude that this Enhanced ElGamal algorithm is not secure.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare: Insights from the COVID-19 Crisis and the Future of HealthTech, Telemedicine, and Connected Health
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study assesses connected health (CH) impact across age groups during COVID-19. We qualitatively analyze CH platforms in Taiwan and mainland China through semi-structured interviews with 23 participants. Findings emphasize CH's role in enhancing health quality, notably in lockdown situations, despite challenges like reimbursement and regulations. Effective leadership and management are crucial for successful CH implementation. Leveraging CH's benefits while addressing obstacles optimizes health outcomes. CH proves vital for health management during COVID-19, with its remote features enhancing quality, underscoring the importance of adept leadership and challenge resolution.

articleTitle: Online Streaming Feature Selection Based on Label Group Correlation and Neighborhood Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Most of the existing multi-label feature selection algorithms select features based on the condition that the feature space is statically known., which may not align well with real-world application scenarios. In this paper., we propose a novel method called label group correlation based online streaming feature selection (LGOFS)., inspired by the neighborhood rough set. Specifically., LGOFS starts by dividing the label set into multiple label groups based on the similarity relationship between labels. Labels within the same group exhibit high correlation., whereas the labels from different groups are relatively weak correlation. Then., neighborhood rough set model., specifically tailored for multi-label learning., is reconstructed based on label correlation. Following this., the importance of features is evaluated using a reconstructed feature dependency function. Finally., we build a streaming feature selection strategy., which includes online importance selection and online subset updating. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed LGOFS algorithm outperforms several popular algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Implementation Effect of Equity Incentive in Taige Pharmaceuticals Based on Projection Pursuit Model
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, a projection pursuit model is employed to investigate Taige Pharmaceuticals, focusing on a detailed examination of its two successive equity incentive plans. Utilizing the “survival of the fittest” principle from the natural world and harnessing computer technology, real-number encoding calculations are performed using MATLAB 2021b to determine the corresponding projection values. This, in turn, facilitates an in-depth analysis of the practical effectiveness of Taige Pharmaceuticals' equity incentives. The findings indicate that both rounds of equity incentives have had a positive impact on the company's future business performance. Furthermore, the application of genetic algorithms reveals that equity incentives can effectively mitigate the adverse effects of abrupt external environmental changes on the company's performance.

articleTitle: Topological Coherence Preserving Retinal Vessel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is a critical step in computer-aided diagnosis of retinal images, providing rich information of vascular morphology. However, existing works primarily focus on achieving high overall segmentation accuracy, often overlooking the errors in the topological structure that lead to disconnected vessels. In order to address these issues, a topological coherence preserving retinal vessel segmentation method is proposed. We adopt a two-stage model by cascading a refinement step after the typical segmentation network to enhance retinal vessel connectivity. A topology-preserving loss is then introduced to guide the refinement network to pay more attention to key regions with topological differences, allowing it to learn the correct topology structure and maximize the preservation of retinal vessel tree connectivity. Experimental results on the DRIVE, STARE, and CHASE_DB1 datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Building a Smart Teaching System Enables Vocational Colleges to Develop in High Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of digitalized education, smart teaching emerges as a quintessential manifestation of educational digital transformation, playing a pivotal role in the advancement of vocational colleges towards high-quality development. Hunan Automotive Engineering Vocational College has embarked on a journey to construct a school-level intelligent platform, harness a diverse spectrum of digital resources, and conceive all-encompassing application scenarios. In parallel, it has ushered in a revamped educational landscape, concurrently propelling the restructuring of pedagogical processes, fostering innovative teaching methodologies, and ushering in a reformation of evaluation practices. Through these groundbreaking initiatives, the institution has laid the foundation for a smart teaching ecosystem, orchestrating an all-encompassing metamorphosis across the dimensions of teaching, learning, administration, and assessment. These transformative efforts have not only bolstered the caliber of talent cultivation but have also empowered the institution's trajectory towards achieving excellence in high-quality development.

articleTitle: Big Data Framework Deployment and Solution Design of Agricultural Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper introduces the overall design scheme of agricultural Internet of Thing (IoT) system and the design framework of software functional modules. By analyzing the MapReduce computing framework of Hadoop, HDFS distributed file storage system, resource allocation and invocation principle of YARN, and the operation framework of Spark. We build the overall structure of the Hadoop-based Spark computing framework and deploy the Hadoop-based Spark cluster.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Interactive Whiteboards in Secondary School Computer Practice Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology in China, informatization teaching has become an important part of teaching in secondary schools. With the deepening of education reform, the scientific integration of multimedia-assisted teaching and computerized teaching can effectively improve the quality of classroom teaching[1]. However, the mechanization of the introduction of multimedia-assisted teaching still makes the classroom teaching stays in the “theoretical explanations in class + student exercises” mode, it is difficult to stimulate students' enthusiasm for learning. In order to solve the problems in the existing computer practical classroom teaching, this paper adds the interactive whiteboard as a supplement to multimedia-assisted teaching to the classroom teaching, and studies the application skills of the interactive whiteboard in the computer practical course, which provides a reference for teachers to use the interactive whiteboard for teaching.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Scale Feature Enhancement and Fusion Method for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Transformer-based neural network techniques have proven highly effective in medical image segmentation tasks. However, their inherent limitations in handling scale-related information may result in an excessive focus on deep semantic details at the expense of essential contextual cues. This can lead to segmentation outputs with gaps and indistinct edges. To address this issue, we have introduced specific strategies to bolster multiscale information integration. Notably, we have devised the Channel-Spatial Interactive Module (CSIM) to promote the harmonious interplay and enrichment of spatial and channel details across different scales. This is followed by the fusion of these features with adjacent-scale counterparts, facilitating mutual guidance for multiscale feature acquisition. Ultimately, we employ a stepwise process of upsampling and information fusion at diverse scales. Our approach has undergone rigorous evaluation across multiple datasets, consistently outperforming alternative methods across a range of metrics.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Application Technology of Precision Machining of CNC Machine Tools Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The CNC machine tools are one of the core equipment of modern manufacturing industries, and their machining accuracy is important to improve product quality and production efficiency. However, during the actual processing process, fluctuations in cutting force, cutting vibration, and cutting temperature as the machine tool ages can adversely affect machining accuracy. Therefore, by collecting a large amount of processing data, deep learning algorithms are used to compensate for process parameters such as cut force, cut vibration and cut temperature in real-time. Experimental results show that deep learning can achieve machining accuracy above 0.96.

articleTitle: Learning to Cluster Person in the Video via Graph Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Video person re-identification is receiving academic interest. However, the practical application of the algorithm is hardly supported because of prohibitive annotated data. Hence, the study for unlabeled data will lead to an attractive alternative. This work explores an innovative strategy, namely, learning to cluster unlabeled person in the video through graph convolutional networks. In this paper, we find that the possibility of inter-frame linkage can be inferred from context. Therefore, a pose-guided topology linkage clustering framework is proposed. Our framework consists of three modules: (i) a pose-guided representation module; (ii) a pose-guided embedding module; (iii) a link prediction module. Firstly, the representation coding alone is performed at the level of relational induction bias, embedding the implicit pose structure information in image features. Then, based on the consideration of the topology relationship between adjacent and cross-frame, graph convolutional network is introduced to infer the likelihood of linkage between frame nodes. Experiments show that the method demonstrates excellent scalability in addition to being an effective response to person clustering in case of changes, and does not need the number of clusters as a prior.

articleTitle: Clinical Study on the Treatment of Perimenopausal Emotional Disorders with Modified Huanglian Wendan Tang
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the effectiveness of modified Huanglian Wendan Tang in treating perimenopausal emotional disorders. Method: Sixty patients with perimenopausal emotional disorders admitted to our hospital from December 2021 to December 2022 were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with Shugan Jieyu Capsule, while the treatment group was treated with Huanglian Wendan Tang. Compare the clinical efficacy, Hamilton Depression Scale (HAMD) scores, and Hamilton Anxiety Scale (HAMA) scores between the two groups before and after treatment. Result: The total effective rate of the treatment group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). After treatment, the HAMD and HAMA scores of the two groups significantly decreased, and the treatment group was significantly lower than the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: The use of modified Huanglian Wendan Tang in the treatment of perimenopausal emotional disorders can significantly improve clinical efficacy, and improve quality of life.

articleTitle: Exploring the impact of parental involvement on student academic achievement in China
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Parents play a crucial role in their children's growth and development, acting as their first teachers in life. They not only establish a close parent-child relationship but also contribute to fostering a positive attitude towards learning and nurturing beneficial study habits. This study aims to investigate the causal relationship between parental involvement and student academic achievement using a data-driven approach. The data for this research is drawn from the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS), a comprehensive nationwide survey project developed and executed by the China Survey and Data Center (NSRC) at Renmin University of China. Different from previous studies, our research focuses on three aspects of parental involvement and their impact on children's academic performance. These three facets encompass emotional involvement, non-emotional involvement, and underlying factors, all of which are utilized to predict variations in student academic achievement. We can draw the following conclusion: (1)Parental involvement has a positive causal effect on students' academic achievement. (2)Emotional support, learning guidance, and the provision of family education resources have varying degrees of impact on academic achievement. (3)Other potential factors play a moderating role in the relationship between parental involvement and academic achievement.

articleTitle: Meta Analysis of Fire Needle Therapy for Swallowing Disorders After Stroke
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effectiveness of fire acupuncture in the treatment of post-stroke dysphagia. METHODS: A computerized search was conducted for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of fire acupuncture in the treatment of post-stroke dysphagia and other therapies in the treatment of post-stroke dysphagia. In addition, the quality of included literature was evaluated and relevant data were extracted. Meta-analysis was performed by using the software Revman 5. 4. Results: Three RCTs involving 196 patients were included in the study. The analysis of the studies showed that relative to swallowing rehabilitation training treatment, the effect of fire needle therapy was more obvious and had an overall effective rate (odds ratio (OR)=2. 82, 95% confidence interval (CI) [1. 17, 6. 79], P<0.05.), and a cure rate (OR=2. 63, 95% CI [ 1. 31, 5. 26], P<0.05.). Conclusion: Compared with other therapies, the treatment of swallowing dysphagia after stroke with fire needle improves the effective rate and dysphagia.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Relaxation Effects through Natural Experiences Using a VR Device
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Relaxation through a natural environment in virtual worlds is proposed for easily experiencing forest-bathing. However, creating the virtual worlds requires costs such as the time to create and technical capabilities. In this study, we compare the relaxation effects of experiencing natural environments using three types of media: a 360-degree video, a 360-degree image, and virtual reality. The purpose is to explore methods for making mental health care with a VR device more accessible. In our approach, we measure stress levels by experiencing natural environments using a VR device by five indicators: electroencephalogram (EEG), heart rate, salivary amylase, the State- Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI), and a subjective stress questionnaire. As a result, no significant differences were found in the relaxation effects of different media for all indicators. The result suggests that the 360-degree video and the 360-degree image, which can be created at a lower cost, may have almost the same relaxation effect as virtual reality.

articleTitle: Social Media Stance Detection Based on Target-Comment Cross-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, social media has gained unprecedented vitality, and the stance detection task generated on this basis also reflects high research value and application value. In the stance detection task, the existence of the target is crucial, and how to use the target to improve the accuracy of prediction has always been a concern for researchers. This research proposes a model based on BERT and attention mechanism, with fully frozen BERT as the encoder, trying to use the target to assign weights to each token of the comment to improve the accuracy of prediction, and after a series of experiments on the binary classification task and the three-category classification task, it is verified that the new model has a certain degree of performance improvement compared with the baseline models. In addition, this research expands the dataset of NLPCC2016 Weibo stance detection task for the Chinese lack of social media stance detection dataset, and conducts relevant experiments on this dataset, and the proposed model also reflects convergence on this dataset, indicating that this expanded dataset has certain use value.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Another Vulnerability to RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: After the famous public key cryptographic system RSA came out in 1978, countless related articles have been discussed in the past 40 years. Even if a new generation of cryptographic algorithms comes out one after another, it still cannot conceal the enthusiasm of many people for RSA research. The research on RSA can not only be approached from a mathematical perspective, but can also be explored from the computer field. This research intends to analyze the public key parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{e}$</tex> and private key parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{d}$</tex> of RSA. This research aims to discuss another vulnerability which parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{ed}\equiv \mathbf{1} ( \boldsymbol{mod}\ \boldsymbol{n})$</tex> or <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{ed}\equiv \mathbf{1} ( \boldsymbol{mod}\ \boldsymbol{\varphi}(\boldsymbol{n}))$</tex>, this is our main purpose. The authors conducted a large number of experiments to prove their viewpoint based on experimental data, is research method used in this article. A weakness problem results from improper selection of parameters such as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{ed}\ \mathbf{mod}\ \boldsymbol{n}$</tex> congruent <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{ed\ mod}\ \boldsymbol{\varphi}(\boldsymbol{n})$</tex>. We will deepen to understanding of RSA algorithm and more security issues by this study.

articleTitle: PVARMAX: Forecasting of Wholesale Prices for Fresh Produce Commodities
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The current difficulty lies in the high correlation between different categories, which leads to insufficient fitness of multi-variable time series and relatively large residuals for some categories. In order to more accurately forecast the whole-sale prices of fresh commodities and to take into account the possible economic effects of mutual exclusion or dependence among different commodity categories, a single-variable time-series forecasting model may be less than optimal. Therefore, we propose the PVARMAX model for forecasting multivariate time series to take into account possible economics effects among commodities as much as possible. We applied the model to the wholesale price data of selected fresh commodities from 2020 to June 2023 and conducted a comprehensive analysis. The results of the study show that the residual analysis of the PVARMAX model is 1.5 % lower than that of the ordinary VARMAX model in the process of forecasting the wholesale prices of cauliflower category commodities. In addition, for the price prediction results of most commodity categories, the PVARMAX model is better than the ARIMA model.

articleTitle: Real-time Student Classroom Feedback with the RFMNet Framework in a Smart Classroom
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is the ability to interpret human feelings from facial features. Teachers can use it to visualize the state of emotion and estimate students' learning effects to take corresponding intervention strategies to improve teaching. The current technology has shortcomings such as network performance degradation and feature information loss, which cannot meet the needs of sentiment analysis of student feedback. Therefore, RFMNet, a novel network model based on deep learning theory, is proposed in this paper. Featuring higher extraction ability, it is conducive to accurately analysing students' expressions. First of all, this model introduces a relation-aware global attention (RGA) module to better integrate the more discriminative expression features in the image and achieve more refined sentiment analysis. Second, the Mish activation function and the focal loss function are employed. The Mish activation function is introduced to avoid disappearing feature information due to neuron deactivation when the ReLU gradient is 0. The model achieves an average recognition accuracy of 89.62%, as confirmed through a sequence of trials conducted on the public dataset FERPlus. The model helps achieve intelligent processing of teaching information and obtaining real-time feedback by detecting, extracting, and analysing the students' facial expressions.

articleTitle: Exploration and Reflection on the Integration of “Ideological and Political Education” into University Physics Classroom Teaching-The Momentum Theorem as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the perspective of new engineering disciplines, promoting the construction of the ideology and politics of “university physics” course is an important measure to implement cultivating moral character, promote curriculum reform and improve the quality of curriculum cultivation. Momentum theorem is one of the important knowledge points of the university physics course, through the introduction of the new class, cleverly designed examples, contact with social life and other specific aspects of the implementation of the “before class, during class, after class “trinity of teaching strategies, to build a student development centered “learning, thinking, and doing” integrated teaching mode. The integrated teaching mode of “learning, thinking, and doing” is constructed to focus on student's development, so as to promote the reform of the deological and political teaching of university physics courses and implement the goal of educating people with moral integrity.

articleTitle: Clinical Observation on the Treatment of Perimenopausal Insomnia with Acupuncture Combined with Modified Huanglian Wendan Tang
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:To explore the effectiveness of acupuncture combined with modified Huanglian Wendan Tang in treating insomnia during perimenopause. Method: Sixty patients with perimenopausal insomnia admitted to our hospital from October 1, 2021 to May 30, 2022 were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with Eszolam tablets, while the observation group was treated with acupuncture combined with modified Huanglian Wendan Tang. Compare the clinical efficacy and Pittsburgh sleep quality index (PSQI) scores between the two groups before and after treatment. Result: The total effective rate of the observation group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). After treatment, the PSQI scores of the two groups significantly decreased, and the observation group was significantly lower than the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: Acupuncture combined with traditional Chinese medicine can significantly improve clinical efficacy, improve insomnia, and improve the quality of life of patients with perimenopausal insomnia, which is worth promoting and applying.

articleTitle: Globally Aware and Locally Sensitive 360° Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Panoramas can show everything within a certain range in an all-encompassing way, making the information learned more direct and comprehensive. However, estimating the depth of a panoramic image is more difficult than estimating the depth of a normal 2D image because the shape of the captured content is distorted in the panoramic image to obtain a larger viewing angle, and it is these distortions that make depth estimation in panoramic images more challenging, and panoramic depth estimation based on the iso-rectangular projection has an unavoidable distortion problem. In this paper, we propose a new method for 360° depth estimation (Global-aware 360° Depth Estimation Network, Ga360-DEN). The method performs global depth estimation on the spherical plane to reduce the distortion that is inevitably introduced when depth estimation is performed on the panoramic image, and utilizes the less distorted and locally accurate depth maps provided on the iso-rectangular projection to extract the details of the depth information from the panoramic image to obtain better depth estimation results. The method is used in comparative experiments on four recognized datasets, in which the root-mean-square error(RMSE) of depth estimation is reduced by 0.051; the RMSE is reduced by an average of 0.025 when compared with mainstream depth estimation methods. The results show that the incorporation of our Ga360-DEN model improves the overall accuracy of depth estimation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development Path of Counselors in Higher Vocational Colleges in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the light of practical demands posed by the digitization of education, “counselors in vocational colleges” have emerged as a central subject of scrutiny and research within the academic sphere. They represent a natural choice for the advancement of the scientific aspects of ideological and political education, as well as a pivotal focal point in the pursuit of high-quality development. This article delves into the essential attributes and competencies expected of counselors operating within the framework of artificial intelligence in vocational colleges. Furthermore, it scrutinizes the formidable challenges they confront in this era and subsequently navigates through specific avenues for the professional growth of vocational college counselors in the backdrop of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Experimental and Practical Teaching System for Statistics Based on “Internet+Education” Smart Teaching and Integrating Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper takes the construction of the experimental practice curriculum system of statistics major in the School of Statistics of Shanxi University of Finance and Economics as an example, based on the concept of “Internet + Education” smart teaching and innovative entrepreneurship education, and studies how to build a statistical experimental practice teaching system that integrates innovative entrepreneurship education under the new teaching method of “Internet + Education” smart teaching, Its fundamental purpose is to promote the organic integration between innovation and entrepreneurship education and statistical experimental practice courses, explore a new educational model - intelligent teaching, achieve the integration of online and offline education models, specifically implement the construction task of Shanxi Province's key discipline of statistics at Shanxi University of Finance and Economics, accelerate the teaching reform of statistics courses, and improve the quality of statistical talent cultivation.

Author Keywords: Construction of Experimental and Practical Teaching System

articleTitle: An Explainable Intelligent Approach for Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis from High-Dimensional Laboratory Test Results
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) constitute a group of chronic ailments that can have sudden onset, emphasizing the crucial need for their prediction and early prevention. The current clinical diagnosis of CVD often requires comprehensive examinations, including laboratory and imaging tests, symptom checks, and physical examinations. These procedures can be time-consuming, labor-intensive, and expensive for patients. Additionally, the utilization of accessible tabular laboratory test results, which are typically high-dimensional and imbalanced, presents substantial challenges for CVD diagnosis. To address these issues, we propose an explainable intelligent approach for CVD diagnosis by analyzing high-dimensional and imbalanced laboratory test results. Firstly, a conditional tabular generative adversarial network is introduced to address the issue of data imbalance. Furthermore, the proposed approach utilizes a one-dimensional convolutional neural network with self-attention mechanism to improve the accuracy and efficiency of CVD diagnosis. Moreover, by extracting the attention vectors, the importance of different features is analyzed to enhance the interpretability of the model. As a result, the proposed approach outperforms other methods by demonstrating improved prediction performance, achieving an accuracy rate of 88.89%. Furthermore, the most influential features that contribute to discovering the CVD diagnosis pattern are identified as risk factors, offering enhanced support for the accurate prevention of CVD.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Prediction of Stock Information Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The stock market has been closely watched by investors because of its high risk and high return characteristics. In order to get a return from the market, they need a scientific investment method. In recent years, deep learning has been widely used in various scenarios, one of which is prediction research in financial markets. In this paper, the tushare tool is used to obtain stock data, the principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimension of the indicators to build an LSTM model, and the extracted indicators are used as model input. Through parameter tuning and model training, a prediction model is finally obtained. The results show that the model has more advantages in long-term prediction. Using this model to predict the stock market can help investors avoid risks to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Based on the Idea of “Ventilation and Ventilation” to Explore the Prevention and Treatment of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the prevention and treatment of lung cancer lesions based on “ventilation and ventilation”. Methods: Referring to some literatures from CNKI from 2006 to 2023, the study on lung cancer by ventilation and ventilation was summarized. The search terms were”traditional Chinese medicine”; Ventilate; Lung cancer; 10 literatures were selected, including 2 doctoral theses and 8 master theses. Result: Based on the scientific hypothesis that improving the function of “lung master qi” and “lung toward 100 veins” promotes “cancer cell death in lung cancer”, combined with relevant literature retrieval analysis, whether it is the primary lung cancer or complicated with other complications, improving lung function can improve arterial blood oxygen partial pressure, and premedication can protect lung tissue from lung ischemia reperfusion injury. It has a significant guiding effect on the clinical study of lung ischemia-reperfusion injury protection and premedication. To explore new ideas and methods for future TCM clinical research. Conclusion: The improvement of lung Qigong is of great significance to the curative effect and life quality of lung cancer patients.

articleTitle: Multivalued Daily Runoff Prediction in Small Watershed Based on Improved CREST Model
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study aims to address a limitation of the CREST distributed hydrological model, which has shown insufficient responsiveness to sudden changes in runoff peaks during long-term daily runoff series in small watersheds, resulting in decreased prediction accuracy. We propose an enhancement by coupling the CREST model with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network, further enriched with the Sparse Multi-headed Self Attention mechanism. The enhanced model is designated as CSSA-GRU (CREST-GRU-Sparse Multi-headed Self Attention). The CSSA-GRU model utilizes runoff data derived from the CREST model and observed daily runoff as inputs, leveraging both GRU and Sparse Multi-headed Self Attention mechanisms for enhanced accuracy in coupled daily runoff predictions. As a case study, we apply the CSSA-GRU model to the Mi River basin in Shandong Province. With a forecasting horizon of 1–3 days, CSSA-GRU demonstrates significant superiority over both the original CREST model and other GRU variants. This is evidenced in its performance on both single-value daily runoff and multi-value coupled daily runoff predictions, where the Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency Coefficients (NSE) are markedly improved, registering at 0.936, 0.846, and 0.767 respectively.

articleTitle: A Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on 2D Images and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Bearings are an important part of rotating machinery., so the accurate diagnosis of bearing faults is essential. Therefore., this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis method that combines two-dimensional (2D) images and the Swin Transformer model. The Swin Transformer model takes the attention mechanism as its core., which can efficiently capture global information of images. First., we use three different methods to convert bearing vibration signals into 2D images., namely gramian angular field (GAF)., short-time Fourier transform (STFT)., and wavelet transform (WT). Secondly., the 2D images are input into the Swin transformer model for feature extraction and fault classification through transfer learning. Finally., the bearing dataset of Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) is used for experiments. The results show that the combination of three different types of 2D images with the Swin Transformer model achieved excellent fault diagnosis results., which is superior to many traditional deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Stroke and Pneumonia by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of Stroke and Pneumonia by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 2276 papers analyzed, it shows that the current Stroke and Pneumonia research hotspots had focused on “COVID-19; Ischemic Stroke; Brain Ischemia; Pneumonia, Viral; Coronavirus Infections; Deglutition Disorders; Pandemics”, etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was COVID-19. Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about Stroke and Pneumonia. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in Stroke and Pneumonia.

articleTitle: Prediction of Medical Health Human Resources in Changchun City Based on Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To predict and analyze the change trend of health human resources in Changchun City during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, so as to provide scientific and reasonable data support for macro policy formulation, and also provide reference for other regions of Jilin Province. Methods: According to the’ Changchun Statistical Yearbook’ and’ Jilin Statistical Yearbook’ from 2018 to 2021, the relevant data of health human resources were selected as the prediction index, and the GM (1,1) prediction model was constructed to predict the change trend of its composition. Results: It is estimated that by 2025, there will be 104,521 health technicians, 60,804 practicing (assistant) physicians, and 87,704 registered nurses in the city. Conclusion: Changchun has abundant health human resources, which can meet the requirements of health planning in Jilin Province. However, there is a certain gap between the doctor-nurse ratio and the national standard. The construction of nursing talent team still needs to be strengthened. In addition, we should pay attention to the guarantee system of medical and health personnel and the cultivation of high-quality medical education.

articleTitle: O-AMAS Teaching Model and its Application in Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics Course
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: O-AMAS is an effective teaching model, which includes five links: teaching objective, activation, multi-learning, assessment and summary. This paper examines the issues critical to understanding and implementing O-AMAS teaching model in the course of Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics. Four classes served as a control group to implement traditional teaching mode in 2022. Three classes served as an intervention group to implement O-AMAS teaching model in 2023. By comparison, the average score of final exam and the number of excellent students have increased, indicating that O-AMAS teaching model can improve the learning effect and student participation.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Based on Kernelized Fuzzy Rough Set for Hierarchical Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Feature selection is an effective approach to mitigate the large scale of data in classification learning. However, there typically exists a hierarchical structure in data. Within this structure, features that offer distinct information for different categories are frequently overlooked. In this paper, we took this difference into account. Firstly, we utilize the hierarchical structure of data to divide classification task into various distinct subtasks. Secondly, the feature distinctions in each category are considered and the hierarchical category dependency is defined. Finally, a new feature selection framework is designed based on the hierarchical category dependency. Compared with the other three feature selection algorithms on four datasets, the experimental results prove the superiority of the algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Visual Data Analysis of the Comprehensive Ability of Vocational Undergraduates (Take the Hainan Science and Technology Vocational University)
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The study centers on vocational undergraduate talent development, with a primary focus on training quality, training systems, and training pathways, which are integral components of vocational education reform. Using the Hainan Science and Technology Vocational University, a National Pilot Vocational College, as a case study, this research employs knowledge charts and data visualization techniques for a comprehensive analysis. It aims to furnish effective vocational training strategies for the enhancement of students' vocational education by visualizing multifaceted aspects of professional competence and academic accomplishments. Furthermore, it offers fresh perspectives to deepen vocational education reform and enhance the quality of vocational undergraduate education. The specific research areas are outlined as follows. Examine the evolution of vocational undergraduate education, along with the learning and practical experiences of students. Begin by gathering educational data as a foundational step for subsequent analysis, followed by conducting surveys;(1)Through a comparative assessment of training and practical experiences, undergraduate students have identified deficiencies and limitations in vocational education. The integration of visual imagery vividly illustrates the intricacies and challenges faced by contemporary students;(2)Utilizing the findings from the analysis, offer pertinent solutions and strategies to foster the sustainability of vocational education.

articleTitle: Construction of Traditional Chinese Medicine Ontology for Pediatric Asthma
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) ontology for pediatric asthma as a tool for subsequent research and applications was developed in this study. Relevant knowledge sharing and reasoning were achieved based on the ontology. OWL was used for describing the ontology language and the “seven-step method” was proposed for ontology construction. The knowledge of pediatric asthma in TCM was extracted manually using protégé (5.6.2) for implementing the knowledge presentation and domain modeling of pediatric asthma in TCM. A total of 63 classes, 276 instances, 16 objects, and 4 data attributes were included in the ontology construction. The knowledge related to pediatric asthma in TCM was organized and represented by the ontology in a more comprehensive manner, achieving the semantic representation of the knowledge of pediatric asthma. The ontology provided knowledge support and reasoning basis for the co-construction and sharing of the knowledge base and the construction of clinical decision support system in the future. Meanwhile, a useful exploration approach of TCM modernization was described.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Multi-Label Text Classification Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To realize Chinese multi-label text classification and recognition, a Chinese multi-label text classification method based on big data technology is proposed. Firstly, semantic information fusion method and fuzzy partition block fusion method are used to extract the semantic similarity features of Chinese multi-label text big data, and combined with semantic ontology feature reconstruction method, a big data analysis model of Chinese multi label text is established. Secondly, the statistical data feature extraction method is used to detect Chinese multi label text features, and the semantic feature extraction model of Chinese multi label text big data is constructed. The fuzzy C-clustering analysis method is used to establish the fuzzy clustering model of Chinese multi label text big data. The multi-level feature information reorganization method is used to reconstruct the fuzzy features of Chinese multi label text big data. The feature reconstruction is carried out according to the semantic attribute characteristics of Chinese multi label text. The Chinese multi label text classification and big data fusion processing are realized, and the Chinese multi label text classification is improved Class recognition ability. The simulation results show that the clustering performance and classification accuracy of this method are better.

articleTitle: Reform and Research on Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching of Operating System Focusing on Cultivating Students' Innovative and Practical Abilities
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Traditional teaching method of the course “Operating System” does not attach importance to cultivating students' innovative and practical abilities. And there are still some issues remained unsolved, like implementation of curriculum ideology with monotonous path, the singularity of teaching means, insufficient articulation between theory and practice, and inadequate emphasis on the process assessment. Based on the development requirement of “New Engineering”, we propose reform and research on online and offline hybrid teaching of Operating System focusing on cultivating students' innovative and practical abilities. We conduct innovative teaching and practice methods during the teaching process. First, we reconstruct teaching resources on Treenity online teaching platform and implement multi-path interactive curriculum ideological and political education. Second, we design a “student-centered” online and offline blended teaching model. Then the course content is optimized with the orientation of “value leadership-theoretical learning-practical improvement”, and the curriculum evaluation system with its continuous improvement is upgraded toward betterment. After three semesters of teaching practice, satisfactory results have been achieved in teaching quality and effectiveness of the course, where the philosophy and purpose of student-centered instruction are better implemented.

articleTitle: Hot Spots and Trends of Computational Thinking Research in China CiteSpace visualization and analysis based on CNKI data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, computational thinking, as one of the core literacy elements of information technology majors, has been widely noticed, and at the same time, it has gradually become one of the core competencies cultivated by education and teaching. This paper uses CiteSpace to visualize and analyze the Chinese core papers related to computational thinking included in CNKI. By studying the current situation of domestic research on computational thinking and related hot keywords, it aims to explore the prospects for the application of computational thinking in secondary education, try to incorporate the educational model of C elements in STEM education, and provide research ideas for the cultivation of computational thinking ability of secondary students.

articleTitle: Based on GeoGebra to Cultivate Geometric Intuitiveness for Middle School Students in Graphic and Geometric Teaching Design - Taking “Rotation of Graphics” as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The deep integration of information technology and mathematics teaching is not only a trend of the times, but also an inherent requirement for cultivating students' core mathematical literacy. Strengthening the intuitive teaching of geometry is beneficial for cultivating students' deep learning and the development of their thinking abilities. In junior high school, one of the teaching objectives in the field of “Graphics and Geometry” aims to cultivate students' geometric intuition ability. However, traditional teaching methods are difficult to achieve efficient classroom teaching effects. Therefore, this article uses GeoGebra software to effectively design the teaching of “Rotation of Graphics”. With the help of GeoGebra software, the rotation process of graphics is dynamically and intuitively displayed to students, improving their geometric intuition and spatial imagination ability, It provides an effective path for the cultivation of core competencies and new concepts and ideas for classroom teaching.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Shopping Cart Based on STM32F40TVET6
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
